mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CIVIL_COMPLAINT ( COMPLAINT_ID, RECEIPT_NO, KIND, LAW_INTERPRET_YN, LEGAL_AFFAIR, ROUTE, APPLICANT_NAME, MOBILE, HOME_PHONE, EMAIL, ADDRESS, NOTIFY_METHOD, TITLE, CONTENT, DEPT, ASSIGNEE, STATUS, RECEIVED_AT, DEADLINE, DEADLINE_AT, REGISTER_ID, ASSIGNEE_ID, PERIOD_DAYS, EXTEND_COUNT ) VALUES ( #{complaintId}, #{receiptNo}, #{kind}, #{lawInterpretYn}, #{legalAffair}, #{route}, #{applicantName}, #{mobile}, #{homePhone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{notifyMethod}, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{dept}, #{assignee}, #{status}, #{receivedAt}, #{deadline}, #{deadlineAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{registerId}, #{assigneeId}, #{periodDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0 )

where.if: AND (RECEIPT_NO LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR TITLE LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR APPLICANT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT COMPLAINT_ID, RECEIPT_NO, KIND, LEGAL_AFFAIR, APPLICANT_NAME, TITLE, DEPT, ASSIGNEE, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS, RECEIVED_AT, DEADLINE, DEADLINE_AT, COMPLETED_AT FROM CIVIL_COMPLAINT
ORDER BY CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, DEADLINE ASC NULLS LAST, RECEIVED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT COMPLAINT_ID, RECEIPT_NO, KIND, LAW_INTERPRET_YN, LEGAL_AFFAIR, ROUTE, APPLICANT_NAME, MOBILE, HOME_PHONE, EMAIL, ADDRESS, NOTIFY_METHOD, TITLE, CONTENT, DEPT, ASSIGNEE, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS, RECEIVED_AT, DEADLINE, DEADLINE_AT, COMPLETED_AT, REGISTER_ID, PERIOD_DAYS, NVL(EXTEND_COUNT, 0) AS EXTEND_COUNT, RESULT_TYPE, RESULT_TEXT, REJECT_REMEDY, RESULT_NOTIFY, COMPLETED_BY FROM CIVIL_COMPLAINT WHERE COMPLAINT_ID = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE CIVIL_COMPLAINT SET DEPT = #{dept}, ASSIGNEE = #{assignee}, ASSIGNEE_ID = #{assigneeId}, STATUS = CASE WHEN #{assigneeId} IS NULL THEN 'RECEIVED' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END WHERE COMPLAINT_ID = #{id} AND STATUS <> 'DONE'

UPDATE CIVIL_COMPLAINT SET DEADLINE = #{deadline, jdbcType=DATE}, DEADLINE_AT = #{deadlineAt}, EXTEND_COUNT = #{extendCount} WHERE COMPLAINT_ID = #{id} AND STATUS <> 'DONE' AND NVL(EXTEND_COUNT, 0) = #{extendCount} - 1

UPDATE CIVIL_COMPLAINT SET STATUS = 'DONE', COMPLETED_AT = #{completedAt}, COMPLETED_BY = #{completedBy}, RESULT_TYPE = #{resultType}, RESULT_TEXT = #{resultText, jdbcType=CLOB}, REJECT_REMEDY = #{rejectRemedy}, RESULT_NOTIFY = #{resultNotify} WHERE COMPLAINT_ID = #{complaintId} AND STATUS <> 'DONE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CIVIL_HISTORY (HIST_ID, COMPLAINT_ID, ACTION, DETAIL, ACTOR_ID, ACTOR_NAME, ACTED_AT) VALUES (#{histId}, #{complaintId}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{actorId}, #{actorName}, #{actedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT HIST_ID, COMPLAINT_ID, ACTION, DETAIL, ACTOR_ID, ACTOR_NAME, ACTED_AT FROM CIVIL_HISTORY WHERE COMPLAINT_ID = #{id} ORDER BY HIST_ID

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RECEIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RECEIVED, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS IN_PROGRESS, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS <> 'DONE' AND DEADLINE <= #{imminentUntil} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS IMMINENT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' AND COMPLETED_AT >= #{monthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DONE_THIS_MONTH FROM CIVIL_COMPLAINT
